tagline: International offshore energy services company specializing in well intervention, robotics and decommissioning operations
hero_kpi_rationale: The $1.3 billion backlog is a key indicator of future revenue visibility for an offshore energy services company, with $694 million expected in 2026, representing 82% of contracts with major clients such as Shell, Subsea 7 and Petrobras

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of signed contracts to be executed
kpis.description: The backlog represents signed contracts scheduled for execution. As of December 31, 2025, the consolidated backlog was $1.3 billion, of which $694 million is expected in 2026
kpis.signal: Slight decline in backlog from $1.4 billion in 2024 to $1.3 billion in 2025, reflecting uncertain market conditions and reduced customer spending

kpis.name: Backlog expected 2026
kpis.explanation: Portion of backlog to be executed over the next 12 months
kpis.description: The backlog expected for 2026 represents 53% of total backlog and demonstrates revenue visibility for the following year
kpis.signal: $694 million of signed contracts for execution in 2026 will provide significant utilization of vessels and equipment

kpis.name: Major customer concentration
kpis.explanation: Percentage of backlog from major contracts with Shell, Subsea 7, Petrobras, Talos, NKT and CNR
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, contracts with Shell and Subsea 7 globally, Petrobras in Brazil, Talos in the Gulf of Mexico, and new multi-year agreements with NKT and CNR in the North Sea collectively represented approximately 82% of total backlog
kpis.signal: High concentration among six major clients provides stability but also exposes the company to concentration risk

kpis.name: 2025 market sentiment
kpis.explanation: Decline in commodity prices in 2025 and uncertain market conditions
kpis.description: Commodity prices fell 20% during 2025, impacting customer spending decisions and creating a prolonged supply-demand imbalance for offshore vessels
kpis.signal: Commodity prices declined 20% in 2025, reflecting a volatile and uncertain market environment

risks.title: Debt-related risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant debt, including senior notes, which could weigh on its financial condition and limit financial flexibility

risks.title: Asset impairment
risks.score_rationale: Long-lived assets, particularly vessels and specialized equipment, are subject to potential impairment in the event of a market slowdown

risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in commodity prices, which declined 20% in 2025, directly affect spending decisions by oil and gas customers

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: 82% of the backlog comes from six major clients, creating significant exposure to the decisions of a limited number of customers

risks.title: Regulatory and geopolitical uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes, including the U.K. Energy Profits Levy and the U.S. Wind Energy Ban in January 2025, create uncertainty for future revenues

ai_positioning.summary: HLX does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K/20-F filings.
